name: Make Yourself Useful

angles.text: As a rogue, you can spot the lack of discipline among amateur thieves when bandits betray their crew to steal stormapples early.

faq.answer: Ferauu leads the bandits who demand a regular share of Windfield Orchard's harvest. He rules his crew with ruthless discipline, though some hungry bandits have slipped in early behind his back.
Windfield Orchard is a local farm that grows stormapples. Ferauu's bandits demand part of its fruit harvest in exchange for leaving the orchard in peace.

aliases: why are bandits at the orchard
faq.answer: Hungry bandits in Ferauu's crew entered the orchard before the scheduled harvest pickup to steal stormapples for themselves. They broke ranks and tampered with the crop, so the orchard keeper asks you to drive them out.
faq.q: Why are hungry bandits prowling the stormapple trees?

faq.answer: Stormapples are a fruit grown at Windfield Orchard. They feed people and make up the harvest tribute Ferauu's bandits demand.

aliases: does ferauu know about the bandits
faq.answer: Ferauu does not know these bandits came early. The orchard keeper says they went rogue, and Ferauu would likely execute them if he caught them taking fruit before his arrival.
faq.q: Does Ferauu know his bandits are sneaking into the orchard?

faq.answer: The orchard caretaker offers you work at Windfield Orchard and watches the groves from a nearby window. Faced with bold newcomers looking for work or food, the keeper tests your mettle by sending you against the intruding bandits.
faq.q: Who tasks you with Make Yourself Useful?

sections.body: Windfield Orchard gives Ferauu's bandits a regular share of its fruit harvest. Ferauu leads the crew, but some outlaws cannot wait for his scheduled visit. They slip into the orchard early to pick stormapples for themselves.
sections.title: Trouble at Windfield Orchard

sections.body: The orchard caretaker puts ambitious newcomers to work before Ferauu arrives. The keeper asks you to secure the ripe stormapples and drive off hungry bandits trespassing among the trees. They have gone behind Ferauu's back to take his share. The keeper says Ferauu would likely execute them for it.
sections.title: Thieves Among Thieves

summary: At Windfield Orchard, Ferauu's bandits are taking stormapples before their share is due. Some hungry outlaws have broken ranks to pick the trees early. Drive them off, and the orchard keeper will respect you.
attribution: In-game quest text: Make Yourself Useful
